cpmplus.w5stick.action.stick.desc: Makes the piece follow another body part in game (head, arm...) without moving it
cpmplus.w5stick.block.animate: Switch to Edit mode: in Animate mode the piece is in the animation's pose and can't be stuck without moving.
cpmplus.w5stick.block.empty: Select the pieces first (a group or cube in the outliner).
cpmplus.w5stick.block.root: "%s" already is a Minecraft body part: a body part can't follow another one.
cpmplus.w5stick.block.noTarget: "%s": the chosen body part doesn't exist anymore. Open the tool again.
cpmplus.w5stick.block.self: "%s" can't follow itself or a group inside it.
cpmplus.w5stick.block.anim: "%s" has position or rotation keyframes and the chosen part is rotated (or it sits in a rotated part): sticking it would change how it moves. Stick it to a part without rotation, or remove those keyframes first.
cpmplus.w5stick.block.bodyRotated: The "body" group is rotated. Moving the pieces into it would turn them with it and they would leave their place. Use "Stick where they are" or remove the body's rotation.
cpmplus.w5stick.single.title: Stick to body part
cpmplus.w5stick.single.intro: "%s" will follow this body part in game. It stays exactly where it is.
cpmplus.w5stick.single.limits: Animations are not rewritten: the piece only starts following the new part's movement. A cube that gets a rotation becomes one extra part in game.
cpmplus.w5stick.field.folder: Create a group for the piece (so it can be animated)
cpmplus.w5stick.field.folder.desc: Creates a group with its pivot at the chosen part's joint and puts the piece inside it.
cpmplus.w5stick.sug.green: Suggested: %s (the piece is inside this part)
cpmplus.w5stick.sug.orange: Please confirm: the piece sits between %s and %s
cpmplus.w5stick.sug.none: No cubes to measure; suggested by the name: %s
cpmplus.w5stick.batch.title: Stick pieces to body parts
cpmplus.w5stick.batch.intro: Each piece will follow the chosen part in game and stays exactly where it is. Check the suggestions (✔ inside the part, ⚠ please confirm).
cpmplus.w5stick.loose.title: Loose pieces
cpmplus.w5stick.loose.intro: These pieces are outside every body part. In game they follow the Body (torso). Choose which part each one should follow (✔ inside the part, ⚠ please confirm):
cpmplus.w5stick.loose.ack.desc: The export stops showing this warning for this project (they keep following the Body).
cpmplus.w5stick.warn.shifted: The %s part was moved away from its normal place: in game the piece will turn around (%s), not the normal joint.
cpmplus.w5stick.warn.copy: "%s" already copies the movement of %s; sticking it there makes it move twice.
cpmplus.w5stick.warn.slot: "%s" has an item slot: it goes along and starts following %s.
cpmplus.w5stick.msg.nothing: Nothing to change: the pieces already are in those parts.
cpmplus.w5stick.msg.doneMany: %s pieces now follow the chosen body parts
cpmplus.w5stick.msg.bodyDone: %s pieces were moved into the Body
cpmplus.w5stick.msg.ackDone: the loose pieces warning is off in this project
cpmplus.w5stick.undo.body: Move loose pieces into the Body
cpmplus.w5stick.warn.loose.one: 1 piece is outside every body part. In game it will follow the Body (torso).
cpmplus.w5stick.warn.loose.many: %s pieces are outside every body part. In game they will follow the Body (torso).
cpmplus.w5stick.warn.loose.rotatedBody: The Body group is rotated: in game they also turn with it.
